body.name: Panel mixed-integer program
body.construction: \(\mathsf P_{\mathrm{MILP}}\) minimizes \(v\) over \(z_c\in\{0,1\}\) and \(b_{\pi xc}\geq0\), including a dummy \(\varnothing\) with \(d_{\pi x\varnothing}=1\), subject to \(\sum_{c\in\mathcal C}z_c\leq k\), \(\sum_{c\in\mathcal C\cup\{\varnothing\}}b_{\pi xc}=1\), \(b_{\pi xc}\leq z_c\) for \(c\in\mathcal C\), and \(\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}q_x\sum_{c\in\mathcal C\cup\{\varnothing\}}d_{\pi xc}b_{\pi xc}\leq v\) for every \(\pi\in\mathcal F\).
